name: [SOUL] Spin a Fem! 🎲
desc:
🎲 Welcome to Spin a Fem!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. 🎲 ROLL to unlock Fems!
2. 💸 Place your Fems on your plot to generate money!
3. 🐾 Unlock pets to increase your luck!
4. 🔁 Rebirth for OP Permanent Boosts!

💲 Remember, your fems earn money even while you're offline!
